talia: Quick follow-up from the pm for gen-service incident. Dropping a short action list so we can close loops. Please claim or reassign by EOD Friday.

 talia: Actions summary (short):
 - A: autoscaler pre-warm + graceful conn drain (goal: reduce 99.9p tail at scale)
 - B: staggered health-check backoffs across AZs (stop simultaneous control-plane load)
 - C: eviction dashboard + alert rule for recurring cache thrash at night
 - D: add deterministic synthetic prompt suite + nightly run (catch regressions)
 - E: on-call runbook update + owner rotation for 90 days

 omar: I can own A. Creating ticket and will attach perf experiment notes.
 omar: INF-4620 created -> ETA 2026-04-08. Experiment plan: baseline + pre-warm enabled, compare tail latency delta.

 neil: I'll pick up B and E (health-check jitter + runbook). Will split into two tickets.
 neil: INF-4621 (health-checks) ETA 2026-04-05. INF-4622 (runbook + rotation) ETA 2026-04-12.

 sasha: I'll take C and D (dashboard + synthetic suite). Will coordinate with Applied ML for prompts.
 sasha: INF-4623 (eviction dashboard) ETA 2026-03-31. INF-4624 (synthetic prompts) ETA 2026-04-15.

 devops-bot: PM doc updated: https://docs.redwood/internal/postmortems/gen-2026-03-incident 12 follow-ups appended.

 talia: For visibility, please paste the JIRA link in the follow-ups doc + set due date. I'll run weekly check-ins until all closed.

 omar: INF-4620 PR opened with experiment harness. Need @neil infra review for drain script.

 neil: Reviewing now, added comments on signal timing. Also tagging @sre for canary policy.

 sasha: INF-4623: added alert logic: fire if eviction rate > 5% for 10m AND tail latency delta > 50ms. Also linked historical spikes.

 sasha: For D, we should seed prompts that mimic long-history chats and high-embedding requests. Will push sample list tomorrow.

 neil: For E (runbook), propose we add explicit reassign steps and postmortem links, and create a 2-week buddy backup rotation.

 talia: RACI for A (autoscaler pre-warm): R=Omar, A=EngRuntime, C=SRE+EngInfra, I=PM+Support. Please confirm.

 omar: Confirmed.

 talia: Scheduling a 20m handoff to sync owners + SRE: Tue 10:00. If conflicts, call it out here.

 neil: Tue 10 conflicts for me, can we do Tue 11?

 talia: Moving to Tue 11:00. Invite sent.

 sasha: I'll present dashboard alerts and demo the synthetic run during handoff.

 talia: Thanks all. Marking postmortem status -> "remediations underway". I'll post a short weekly summary in this thread; ping me if any deadlines slip or owners need to hand off. :white_check_mark:
